meta.description: Build the Flutter UI against a mock daemon data source (no Rust daemon yet). Every task that touches data must go through the DaemonRepository contract documented in docs/contracts/, never bypass it, so a real daemon can be dropped in later without UI changes.

designSource.origin: Claude Design canvas, exported as a zip and read locally (design/claude-design-export/, gitignored — not committed)
designSource.note: The .dc.html files are a JS prototype (DCLogic class components, sc-if/sc-for template directives, inline style objects) — a visual/interaction reference to re-implement natively in Flutter, not code to port line-for-line. support.js is just the canvas runtime that executes them; no app logic lives there.

meta.howToUseThisFile: Each task's designContext carries enough of the original design (exact copy strings, token values, state lists, sizes) to implement it without re-opening the export. sharedDesignTokens holds the global values (colors, motion, radii) referenced by id from individual tasks instead of being repeated. Update a task's status and add a commit field (short sha + message) when you finish it — that's the record of what's actually landed vs. still planned.

tracks.name: Foundation: contracts, domain model, mock data
tracks.description: Everything downstream depends on this: the documented contract, the Dart types that satisfy it, and the in-memory mock that stands in for the daemon this session.

tasks.title: Document Flutter↔daemon contracts
tasks.description: Write docs/contracts/{README,data-model,daemon-ipc,CHANGELOG}.md defining the DaemonRepository interface, wire JSON shapes, RPC command table, event list, and the pairing/switching/link-health state machines. Device.state reuses flow_core::device::DeviceState's six variants verbatim so the Rust side can serialize its existing enum with no translation layer.
acceptanceCriteria: Every entity in data-model.md has both a Dart shape and a JSON example.
daemon-ipc.md lists every command/event the mock will implement, with preconditions and effects.
Explicitly notes which mock timings are contractual (state sequence) vs incidental (exact delay ms).

designContext.note: Contract is derived from the state shape both .dc.html components already use: Component.state.devices (id/name/os/status), state.connState (6-value enum), pairing popView/pairStep machine, state.toggles + sensitivity + switchKey. See daemon-ipc.md for the exact mapping.

tasks.title: Domain entities
tasks.description: Create the Dart types from data-model.md: Device, HostOs, DeviceState, DaemonLinkState, PairingCandidate, PairingSession, PairingStage, SwitchKeyBinding, FlowSettings, PointerSensitivity, PermissionStatus, SettingsPatch. Plain immutable classes (const constructors, copyWith where mutated), no codegen — YAGNI, this project doesn't need freezed/json_serializable for a handful of small types.
acceptanceCriteria: Types match data-model.md field-for-field.
`flutter analyze` clean, no lint suppressions.
No dependency on Flutter widgets in domain/ — pure Dart, so it's testable without a widget test harness (separation of concerns).

designContext.sourceState: Component.state in Cross-Device UI v2.dc.html: devices: [{id,name,os,status}], toggles: {launchAtLogin,showTray,autoReconnect,autoConnect,shareKeyboard,shareMouse,debugLogging}, sensitivity: 'normal', switchKey: 'Scroll Lock'.
designContext.presets: PRESETS = ['Scroll Lock', 'Pause', 'F13', 'Ctrl + Shift + Space'] — use as SwitchKeyBinding.presets static list.

tasks.title: DaemonRepository abstract interface
tasks.description: flutter/lib/domain/daemon_repository.dart: the abstract class from daemon-ipc.md — 5 watch* streams, 9 commands. This is the seam every UI feature and the mock both depend on; nothing else in lib/ may reference MockDaemonRepository directly.
acceptanceCriteria: Method signatures match daemon-ipc.md exactly.
Doc comments on the class point back to docs/contracts/daemon-ipc.md.

designContext.note: No new design context — this is the interface daemon-ipc.md already specifies.

tasks.title: MockDaemonRepository
tasks.description: In-memory implementation of DaemonRepository using StreamControllers (broadcast, seeded with current state on listen). Reproduce the exact state machines and seed data from the .dc.html prototype so the UI feels alive: 3 seed devices, pairing timing (~1.2s to find, ~1.5s to accept, ~1.6s auto-return to idle), 400ms switch debounce, two pairing candidates (Office Mac Mini, Studio Linux) that disappear once paired.
acceptanceCriteria: Every DaemonRepository method implemented, no UnimplementedError.
Pairing/switching sequences match the state machines in daemon-ipc.md.
Emits an initial value on every stream immediately on listen (contract: 'connecting to the channel and subscribing is the initial fetch').

designContext.pairingCandidates: ['Office Mac Mini', 'Studio Linux'] — filtered to exclude names already in the device list
designContext.quote: TrayPopover.dc.html switchTo(): sets switching:id, then after 400ms flips devices[id].status='active' and demotes the previous active to 'inactive'.

tasks.title: Riverpod state wiring
tasks.description: Add flutter_riverpod. flutter/lib/state/: a repositoryProvider (Provider<DaemonRepository>, default MockDaemonRepository, overridable in tests and later for a real IPC client), StreamProviders for devices/linkState/pairingSession/settings/permission, and any small transient UI-only state (theme mode override, tray-open bool) as separate providers so daemon-derived state and pure-UI state never live in the same notifier.
acceptanceCriteria: Widgets never construct MockDaemonRepository directly, only via ref.watch(repositoryProvider) or the derived stream providers.
`flutter analyze` clean.

designContext.note: Pure wiring task, no new design context beyond F1-F4.
